execution_roadmap: .docs/roadmap/24-harness-capability-next-90.md

VANTARI is a local Zig agent kernel. Prompts control voice, pace, initiative,
delegation, and interaction cadence. The kernel controls executable capability,
durability, budgets, evidence, recovery, and irreversible-action gates.

TUI Shift+Tab cycles the session-local prompt mode `orchestrate`, `build`,
`align`, `plan`; the next `session/send` carries the exact label, omission
defaults to `orchestrate`, and unknown labels fail before execution. Prompt mode
changes provider guidance only; it does not change the executor, tools, access,
model, or capacity.

Canonical execution path:
operator input -> public LocalClient facade -> project-local execution owner ->
private ChildClient -> kernel-stdio -> transcript/context/provider/tools/events ->
durable terminal state.

Canonical runtime state:
.var/sessions/<session-id>/session.json
.var/sessions/<session-id>/messages.jsonl
.var/sessions/<session-id>/context.jsonl
.var/sessions/<session-id>/events.jsonl
.var/sessions/<session-id>/output.txt

Owner state:
.var/runtime/execution-owner.json
apps/backend/src/host/owner_client.zig
apps/backend/src/host/owner_state.zig
apps/backend/src/host/http_bridge.zig
apps/backend/src/host/stdio_client.zig
apps/backend/src/core/agents/spec.zig
apps/backend/src/core/agents/service.zig
apps/backend/src/core/agents/mailbox.zig

Rules:
- Clients render kernel-owned state and never assemble provider context.
- One workspace has one owner, one private kernel child, one agent pool, and one
  scheduler composition.
- Client exit does not stop the owner. Foreground serve and automatic owner start
  share one lease.
- Tickets own work lifecycle. Assignment is queue admission, not execution.
- agent_routes.max_concurrency is the sole ticket execution capacity setting;
  running is active, idle=max-running, queued is admitted backlog, and
  available=idle-queued saturated at zero. A changed value replaces the same
  pool at its next idle boundary; there is no tickets execution-policy branch.
- messages.jsonl remains complete and append-only. context.jsonl is a model-visible
  checkpoint ledger, not a transcript.
- Use typed tools and advertised availability. search_files requires iex.
- runtime.full_access_mode is false by default and never relocates .var.
- Auth uses one provider ledger: installed `$VANTARI_HOME/auth.json` or
  workspace `.var/auth.json`; `auth status --json` is secret-free, `auth login
  openai-codex` owns PKCE persistence, and `auth logout <provider-id>` removes
  one record. OAuth `openai-codex` routes through `core/providers/openai_codex.zig`
  to `/codex/responses` with account/originator metadata; API-key providers keep
  the OpenAI-compatible route and never fall back across the auth boundary.
- Scheduler leadership is process-exclusive and generation-fenced in source.
- Ticket claim, worker generation, lease, capability, and deterministic child
  identity commit in one process-serialized ticket row before child creation.
- Expired claims settle terminal evidence first. Existing nonterminal sessions
  resume through one generation-fenced ticket row with the same attempt, receipt,
  transcript, and mailbox cursor; only absent sessions requeue. Heartbeat requires
  exact live Supervisor ownership.
- agents {} returns var1.agent_eligibility.v1: sorted route-resolvable
  specialists, unavailable route classes, fixed-pool/team pressure,
  communication choices, and a SHA-256 receipt. Prompts choose solo, inspect,
  message, challenge, launch, queue, or wake; launch/config revalidates effects.
- Agent messaging uses one events.jsonl mailbox: direct, parent, current_group;
  queue/wake; durable recipient sequence, sender receipt, and provider-success
  unread cursor. Messages never assign tickets, launch work, or copy transcripts.
- The source and installed Windows lifecycle meshes prove queue-only assignment,
  one claim, client detach, exact owner-tree loss, generation replacement,
  same-session resume, nested direct/group/parent delivery, one terminal ticket,
  cold readback, and zero proof-owned processes. Do not infer exactly-once
  arbitrary external effects; that remains a separate roadmap gate.

Commands from apps/backend:
scripts/zigw.ps1 build test --summary all
zig-out/bin/vantari.exe health --json
zig-out/bin/vantari.exe run --prompt "..."
scripts/prove-ticket-lifecycle.ps1 -BinaryPath zig-out/bin/vantari.exe
zig-out/bin/vantari.exe serve --port 4310
scripts/prove-owner-tracer.ps1 -BinaryPath zig-out/bin/vantari.exe -EntryPoint serve
scripts/prove-owner-lifecycle.ps1 -BinaryPath zig-out/bin/vantari.exe -ConcurrentClients 20
